questions.question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only six people sit to the left of D. Only four people sit between E and F. B sits third to the right of F. G sits to the immediate left of A. How many people sit between C and A?

Each of C, D, E, F, W, X and Y has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.F has exam on Thursday. Only C has exam between Y and F. Only four people have exams between D and Y. C has exam on one of the days after Y. E's  exam is immediately on the day before X's. D has exam after Y.Who has exam on the first day of the week?

Varun starts from Point A and drives 13 km north. He then takes a left turn, drives 19 km, turns left and drives 14 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 21 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 1 km, and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction should he drive to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns unless specified.)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (2 km to the west) है।

Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing four people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. In row 1 – H, A, V and E are seated and all of them are facing south In row 2 – M, N, O and P are seated and all of them are facing north. Thus, each person faces another person from the other row. No one sits to the left of O. No one sits to the left of V. Only one person sits between N and O. The one facing P sits second to the right of V. A sits second to the right of H.Which of the following represents both people sitting at extreme ends of the line?6450
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (M and A) है।

Given below is a statement (cause) followed by possible effects numbered I, II and III. Read the cause carefully and decide which of the three can be possible effect(s).Cause: A multinational corporation announced massive layoffs due to declining profits.Effects: I. Unemployment rates in the region have increased.II. Employee unions have called for protests against the company.III. The company’s stock prices surged immediately after the announcement.
options: Only II is a possible effect.
Only I and II are possible effects.
Only II and III are possible effects.
Only I is a possible effect.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Only I and II are possible effects.) है।
